faq_items.q: What is Study Topper and how does it help candidates?
faq_items.a: Study Topper (studytopper.in) is a premier educational information platform providing instant, verified alerts for government vacancies, exam syllabus, admit cards, answer keys, and merit lists.

faq_items.q: How frequently are exam results and admit cards updated?
faq_items.a: Our notification engine updates all official notifications 24/7 in real-time as soon as released by government recruiting agencies.

faq_items.q: Is any registration fee required to browse notifications?
faq_items.a: No, all recruitment updates, syllabus downloads, and candidate tools on StudyTopper.in are 100% free for all aspirants.
